mainEntity.name: What if I cannot afford a post-concussion syndrome attorney?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most personal injury attorneys, including those specializing in post-concussion syndrome cases, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the compensation they secure for you, whether through a settlement or a court award. If they don't win your case, you generally don't owe them attorney fees. This arrangement makes legal representation accessible to individuals regardless of their financial situation.
